findings.title: Monthly Revenue Trend
findings.evidence: Monthly revenue shows a peak in Q3 2024 and a dip in Q1 2025.
findings.method: Time series aggregation of revenue by month.
findings.limitations: Missing data for some months due to incomplete transaction logs.

findings.title: Top 10 Products by Revenue
findings.evidence: Products P01, P02, and P03 dominate revenue.
findings.limitations: Does not account for profit margins per product.

findings.title: Revenue by Region
findings.evidence: Region R0 leads revenue, R3 lags.

findings.title: Revenue Share by Customer Segment
findings.evidence: Enterprise segment accounts for ~55% of revenue.

findings.title: Monthly Stockouts Trend
findings.evidence: Stockouts peaked in January 2024 and declined thereafter.
findings.limitations: Stockouts may not reflect actual demand.

findings.title: Discount vs Revenue Correlation
findings.limitations: Correlation does not imply causation; other factors may influence revenue.
